In recent years, the wave of artificial intelligence has repeatedly reshaped people's imaginations: models have grown larger, computing power stronger, and applications broader. Yet behind the impressive achievements, a deeper issue has consistently emerged—does AI truly "understand" the world? It can recall conversations but often forgets context; it can generate answers but may not grasp the origins of questions. People are beginning to realize that the boundary of intelligence lies not in algorithms but in context.

Against this backdrop, the Generative AI Lab at Shanghai Jiao Tong University (GAIR Lab) has proposed a groundbreaking perspective: the essence of AI is not a revolution in computing power but a "context revolution." In their latest paper, they elevate "context" from a peripheral concept in language models to the core structure of intelligent systems, arguing that how a system understands the world depends on how it absorbs, organizes, and reconstructs context.

By tracing the evolution of context systems and integrating extensive experiments with theoretical modeling, the research introduces a new disciplinary framework called "Context Engineering." The team found that from the early Context 1.0, reliant on sensors and rules, to the more advanced Agent 2.0 capable of cross-modal semantic understanding, each leap in AI represents an upgrade in "context absorption capability."

At a time when parameter growth is nearing its limits, this research points toward a new path for AI: when machines no longer just remember context but can understand and create it, perhaps that will mark the true dawn of the intelligent era.
excerpt_i18n.es: En los últimos años, la ola de inteligencia artificial ha renovado una y otra vez la imaginación de las personas: los modelos se han vuelto más grandes, la potencia de cálculo más fuerte y las aplicaciones más amplias. Pero detrás de los brillantes logros, un problema más profundo se ha expuesto continuamente: ¿realmente la IA "comprende" el mundo? Puede recordar conversaciones, pero a menudo olvida el contexto; puede generar respuestas, pero no necesariamente entiende el origen de las preguntas. La gente ha comenzado a darse cuenta de que el límite de la inteligencia no está en el algoritmo, sino en el contexto. Es en este contexto que el Laboratorio de Inteligencia Artificial Generativa de la Universidad Jiao Tong de Shanghai (GAIR Lab) ha propuesto una perspectiva revolucionaria: la esencia de la inteligencia artificial no es una revolución de la potencia de cálculo, sino una "revolución del contexto". excerpt_i18n.en: When it comes to the core term for competition in 2025, autonomous driving may be the most representative. As the new energy industry has evolved, with the three-electric systems gradually maturing and becoming homogeneous, electrification itself has shifted from a disruptive innovation to a basic threshold, making autonomous driving the new competitive focus, and the cycle of historical breakthroughs is set to repeat. In the 2000s, the internet era saw Windows and Intel build the foundational architecture of the digital world. In the 2010s, the mobile internet era saw Apple reshape how people connect with information. In the 2020s, OpenAI pushed digital cognition to new frontiers. Today, with AI continuously advancing, its expansion beyond the digital world has become a consensus among leading tech companies. While Apple increases its investment in generative AI, it has also been revealed to be developing a desktop robot with autonomous navigation capabilities, exploring AI's interactive abilities in physical spaces. Amazon's Astro home robot and DeepMind's ongoing investments in robot control models show that tech giants view "physical AI" as the key gateway to the next generation of human-machine interaction. excerpt_i18n.es: Al hablar de la palabra clave de la competencia en 2025, la conducción autónoma podría ser la más representativa. En la era de Internet de los años 2000, Windows e Intel construyeron la infraestructura subyacente del mundo digital. En la era de la Internet móvil de los años 2010, Apple reinventó la forma en que las personas se conectan con la información. En los años 2020, OpenAI ha llevado la cognición digital a nuevos límites. Hoy en día, tras la continua evolución de la IA, su expansión más allá del mundo digital ya es una realidad para las principales empresas tecnológicas.

items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网11月4日消息，昆仑万维旗下AI视频创作平台SkyReels正式焕新上线，Web端与移动端APP同步登陆全球市场。 SkyReels的诞生可追溯至2023年。自项目启动以来，SkyReels技术团队致力于解决长视频生成、角色一致性、动作精准控制等核心痛点。 今年以来，SkyReels动作频繁：2月，面向AI短剧创作的开源视频模型SkyReels-V1正式发布，这是国内首个面向 AI 短剧创作的开源视频模型。4月，推SkyReels-V2模型首次引入“扩散强迫”技术框架，实现无限时长视频生成与细节精准控制；8月，SkyReels-A3音频驱动模型上线，突破全模态音频驱动数字人创作的时长限制。 至此，SkyReels完成了从基础模型到应用层的全链条技术覆盖，AI视频创作平台SkyReels的全面焕新上线也顺理成章。 昆仑万维员工向星（化名）告诉雷峰网，昆仑万维创始人周亚辉亲自在带天工和AI短剧业务，AI短剧的相关业务负责人直接向周亚辉汇报。 此次正式上线的SkyReels，定位为“一站式AI视频创作平台”，集成图片生成、视频生成、数字人、音乐生成等全场景功能。包括五大核心功能——无限画布、Agent智能、视频模板、“会接话”的数字人、视频延长与风格化，进一步降低了创作门槛。 昆仑万维员工向星（化名）向星告诉雷峰网，字节跳动在海外短剧平台的布局相对谨慎，短期内似乎没有大规模推进的计划，这被昆仑万维视为一个机会。目前，海外市场上一些热门的平台，比如ReelShort等，虽然表现不错，但资金实力都不如昆仑万维。因此，昆仑万维认为，可以凭借资金优势大力投入，快速在海外市场占据一席之地。 雷峰网获悉，昆仑万维正通过大规模购买流量和IP资源，积极拓展海外市场。SkyReels的全面上线，进一步为创作者提供了相对完善的短剧制作的技术支持，帮助他们更高效地生成内容。
